_about: Districts, places, and routes for the Explore map. Pins are fractions of the map image (0-1). Edit with Explore > Edit pins, then download places.json and replace this file. routes: walk/tram are minutes; estimate means the time is not printed on a map. Optional per route: walkRange/tramRange [min,max], goblin (minutes by goblin rooftop and tunnel routes, for the Runner view), source. districts[].atlas: pin on the City tab's PDA atlas art (x/y in percent), its label and note. districts[].dossier: the City tab's district dossier.

clock._about: Adyta time runs at real speed. At anchorReal it was anchorAdyta in Adyta.

travel._about: Places pinned on the city map (no district map yet) count as in their district; travel inside a district takes withinDistrictMinutes.

dossier.wisdom: Rooftops are faster. Being rude is slower.

atlas.label: Low Halo

places.artAlt: The Hive reference sheet: the five-story brick block at night, the south service alley, the U-shaped courtyard from above, Ma Dresk at The Ground-Floor Fryer, and the communal landing with its two elevators and the stairs.

details.title: The building
items: Five stories, U-shaped around a central courtyard.
Shops on the ground floor, including The Ground-Floor Fryer.
Like most of Low Halo: run-down, with plenty of unofficial, unauthorized repairs.

details.title: Who runs it
items: Ma Dresk, a mostly friendly older dwarf woman. She owns the building.
She also runs The Ground-Floor Fryer downstairs.

details.title: Rent and favors
items: Late? You get one week's grace.
After that she calls in a favor: fix her walk-in, run a parcel, or scare off a debt collector.

details.title: Getting around
items: Two elevators. Neither works often enough for anyone to rely on.

Inside it's warmer than it has any right to be: a muttering kettle, low glitchy music, a workbench of half-fixed devices, a chalkboard of route notes, and a curtain in the back that probably doesn't lead where the building permit says it should.
